base_member_text: [L2138-L2193] (MED/relative-density-inconsistency) intra_sedtr defines ratio_s=(rhos-rho)/rho but then uses ratio_s-1 in dstar, unlike the same standard calculation elsewhere in the file.
audit_member_text: [L2185-L2198] (HIGH/relative-density formula) intra_sedtr defines ratio_s=(rhos-rho)/rho and then uses ratio_s-1 in dstar, subtracting unity twice relative to the submerged-density ratio used elsewhere.

base_member_text: [L70-L138, L619-L630, L1361-L1433, L1886-L1942, L2536-L2619] (LOW/lifecycle-contract) Multiple saved workspaces are allocated once from the first grid and option set with no shape or option-change checks, making library reuse with changed configuration unsafe.
audit_member_text: [L70-L138,L619-L630,L1218-L1226,L1361-L1433,L1886-L1942,L2536-L2619,L2863-L2871,L3013-L3030,L3086-L3095,L3183-L3187,L3235-L3238] (LOW/state/dimension lifecycle) Many saved work arrays are allocated only on first use and never resized or reconfigured, so changed grid, grain, layer, or formulation settings in a later lifecycle retain incompatible state.

base_member_text: [L1886-L1916] (HIGH/unallocated-access) Nielsen2006 allocates fe only when streaming is enabled but assigns fe=0 unconditionally, accessing an unallocated array when streaming is off.
audit_member_text: [L1886-L1915] (HIGH/unallocated optional work array) Nielsen2006 allocates fe only when streaming==1 but assigns fe=0 unconditionally, so streaming-disabled initialization accesses an unallocated allocatable array.

base_member_text: [L3032-L3036] (MED/zero-wavenumber-singularity) The Ursell number divides by (k*hh)^3 before applying its lower clamp, so zero k or depth yields non-finite intermediate values.
audit_member_text: [L3032-L3036] (HIGH/dry-cell invalid arithmetic) RvR forms the Ursell number with (k*hh)^3 in the denominator before applying a lower bound, so zero k or depth produces NaN that max does not neutralize.

base_member_text: [L1664-L1682] (MED/signed-concentration) Van Rijn 1993 activates bed load using nonnegative speed ue but computes and divides by signed used=vmg+ua, allowing negative or singular equilibrium concentration.
audit_member_text: [L1672-L1680] (HIGH/zero/negative transport velocity) Van Rijn bed load gates on ue>Ucrb but then divides by used=vmg+ua, which can be zero or negative independently and produce invalid or sign-reversed concentration.

base_member_text: [L985-L995, L1089-L1099] (HIGH/mass-conservation) Avalanche deposition edg1 multiplies edg2 by sedcal a second time, so erosion and deposition masses differ whenever a sediment calibration factor is not one.
audit_member_text: [L968-L988,L1073-L1093] (HIGH/layer-bound overrun and double calibration) Avalanche erosion searches depth layers without an nd bound, and deposition multiplies edg2 by sedcal a second time, applying sedcal squared and potentially failing mass conservation.

base_member_text: [L819-L830] (MED/unit-inconsistency) During groundwater-coupled erosion tempexchange is a water-depth amount but is added directly to the infiltration rate without division by dt, unlike the accretion branch.
audit_member_text: [L817-L830] (HIGH/unit/time-scale inconsistency) Groundwater coupling adds accretion exchange to infil as depth divided by dt, but erosion exchange is added without dividing by dt.

base_member_text: [L1218-L1226] (MED/workspace-shape) update_fractions sizes saved work arrays from nd(1,1) and never checks the current cell's nd(i,j), so spatially varying layer counts can exceed or mismatch the workspace.
audit_member_text: [L1218-L1226] (HIGH/heterogeneous-layer bounds) update_fractions sizes scratch arrays from s%nd(1,1) but indexes them using each target cell's nd and par%nd_var, which can overrun when layer counts vary spatially.

base_member_text: [L1752-L1756] (MED/configuration-singularity) The vertical integration grid divides by kmax-1, so kmax=1 is unsupported without an explicit parameter guard.
audit_member_text: [L1752-L1756] (MED/unchecked vertical resolution) The concentration grid divides by kmax-1 and therefore requires kmax>=2 without checking that contract.

base_member_text: [L437-L453, L1557-L1578] (MED/angle-singularity) Transport and slope directions use atan(y/x) with manual quadrant handling and still divide by zero for vertical vectors, rather than a two-argument angle function.
audit_member_text: [L437-L453] (MED/angle/quadrant handling) Talmon direction calculations use atan of component ratios rather than atan2, including a possible zero denominator and loss of the correct quadrant for the adjusted transport direction.

base_member_text: [L357-L373] (MED/division-before-mask) The Surfbeat berm-slope condition evaluates H/hu across the array without protecting zero hu before the logical selection.
audit_member_text: [L360-L366] (HIGH/dry-face division) The Surfbeat berm-slope mask evaluates H/hu across the full grid without a wet or positive-depth guard.

base_member_text: [L1218-L1239, L1318] (HIGH/nontermination) update_fractions loops until an exact floating-point zero and has no escape when dzbt becomes zero because a limiting layer thickness is zero, so dzb_loc may never decrease.
audit_member_text: [L1234-L1240] (HIGH/nonterminating exact-residual loop) The fraction update loops until a floating residual is exactly zero and can make zero progress when a limiting layer thickness is zero, with no tolerance or iteration cap.

base_member_text: [L2943-L2956] (HIGH/uninitialized-variable) In 2-D turbulence advection disturb is assigned only when betad>0 but is used unconditionally in the kturb update, leaving it undefined for betad<=0.
audit_member_text: [L2943-L2956] (HIGH/uninitialized sink term) In 2-D turbulence advection, disturb is used after the betad<=0 branch where its only assignment is commented out.

base_member_text: [L2282-L2291] (HIGH/division-before-mask) intra_sedtr computes ceqbg by dividing Subg by hh*uu before zeroing subcritical transport, so zero velocities generate NaN or infinity that the later Subg mask does not remove from ceqbg.
audit_member_text: [L2282-L2303] (HIGH/unguarded concentration division/stale output) ceqbg is formed by dividing bed transport by hh*uu before the low-shear mask is applied, and the bed-disabled branch clears Subg but not ceqbg.

base_member_text: [L2442-L2473] (MED/concentration-singularity) The analytical concentration profile divides by hh-za and the final depth average divides by hh without handling the hh=za or zero-depth limits.
audit_member_text: [L2431-L2473] (HIGH/singular concentration integration) Suspended concentration divides by hh-za and hh without ensuring water depth exceeds the reference height or is positive.

base_member_text: [L290-L298] (HIGH/shape-mismatch) At a right MPI boundary uev_sed(:,1:ny+1) is assigned from uev_sed(:,1:ny), a nonconformable array assignment that appears intended to copy only the final column.
audit_member_text: [L290-L307] (HIGH/nonconformable array assignment) At the right MPI boundary, uev_sed(:,1:ny+1)=uev_sed(:,1:ny) assigns arrays with different extents instead of assigning only the final column.

base_member_text: [L225-L237, L290-L307] (MED/partial-array-update) Several sediment-velocity interpolants leave nx+1 or ny+1 entries untouched except on selected physical boundaries, yet full-array magnitudes and transports consume those entries.
audit_member_text: [L225-L237] (HIGH/uninitialized boundary values) With nz>1, ueu_sed and veu_sed are filled only through nx, while whole-array velocity magnitudes immediately consume their nx+1 boundary; non-bottom MPI ranks do not initialize that boundary.

base_member_text: [L2873-L2881, L2943-L2967] (MED/depth-division) The turbulence update divides by hh over active loop ranges without an explicit wet/depth guard, relying on an upstream depth floor.
audit_member_text: [L2943-L2967] (HIGH/dry-cell division) Turbulence updates divide by hh over unmasked interior ranges, allowing dry cells to generate invalid values.

base_member_text: [L2321-L2327] (HIGH/wrong-component-mask) The negative-slope branch for y-direction Nielsen correction tests dzbdx<0 instead of dzbdy<0, skipping or misapplying the alongshore slope correction.
audit_member_text: [L2321-L2327] (HIGH/wrong directional condition) The negative y-slope Nielsen branch tests dzbdx<0 instead of dzbdy<0, so many negative y slopes bypass correction.

base_member_text: [L413-L419] (MED/operator-precedence) The bed-slope exclusion applies only to the Svb half of an OR expression, so any nontrivial Sub enters the Soulsby adjustment even where bermslopeindexbed is true.
audit_member_text: [L411-L420] (MED/boolean precedence) The bed-slope magnitude condition applies the non-berm mask only to the Svb alternative, so any nontrivial Sub is modified even where bermslopeindexbed is true.

base_member_text: [L1475-L1484] (MED/division-precondition) Bore turbulence divides by Tbore and the runup jet uses indexed hh in a square-root denominator without local positive guards or index validation.
audit_member_text: [L1475-L1483] (MED/unchecked period/depth index) Bore turbulence divides by Tbore and the runup jet indexes nint(istruct) and divides by local hh without bounds or positive-value checks.

base_member_text: [L2799-L2807] (HIGH/division-by-zero) Bulk McCall-Van Rijn concentration is formed as qsedu/(hu*uu) over the whole array without a wet or nonzero-velocity mask.
audit_member_text: [L2800-L2807] (HIGH/unguarded bulk concentration division) Bulk McCall-Van Rijn concentration divides qsedu by hu*uu over the whole grid, including dry faces and zero-flow wet faces.

base_member_text: [L2094-L2104, L2778-L2785] (HIGH/stale-loop-index) Both smoothed bed-load implementations set the top boundary from qsedu(i,:) after the i loop has finished, when i is nx+1, instead of using the top boundary or adjacent cell.
audit_member_text: [L2094-L2103,L2778-L2785] (HIGH/wrong boundary source index) After the smoothing loop, both transport routines set the top boundary from qsedu(i,:) where loop variable i has advanced to nx+1, copying the opposite boundary rather than qsedu(1,:).

base_member_text: [L1170-L1177] (HIGH/whole-array-overwrite) Inside the i,j loop the representative-size update assigns scalar sums to the entire D50top and D90top arrays rather than to (i,j), leaving every cell equal to the last loop cell.
audit_member_text: [L1171-L1177] (HIGH/missing spatial indexing) D50top and D90top are assigned as whole arrays inside the i,j loops, so every iteration overwrites the entire field and the final cell's mixture becomes global.

base_member_text: [L2918-L2926] (HIGH/wrong-source-array) At zero v velocity, kturbv is averaged from its own just-zeroed values rather than from neighboring s%kturb values, forcing the centered face turbulence to zero.
audit_member_text: [L2918-L2926] (HIGH/self-referential stale interpolation) At zero V velocity, kturbv is averaged from kturbv itself rather than from s%kturb, reusing stale work-array values instead of the neighboring turbulence field.
dispositions.rationale: blinded CONFLICT: Same self-interpolation, but prior stale values versus just-zeroed values

base_member_text: [L250-L260, L279, L320-L330, L354, L464-L490] (HIGH/double-fraction-weighting) cub/cvb already include the active-layer pbbed fraction before bed-load transport is formed, but Sub/Svb are multiplied by another upwind pbbed factor afterward, apparently squaring fraction availability.

[L181-L188, L2151-L2170] (HIGH/repeat-allocation) intra_sedtr allocates SAVE allocatables unconditionally on every call, so its normal use from repeated transus timesteps will attempt to allocate already allocated arrays.

[L751-L768, L791-L807, L944-L1005, L1050-L1108, L1322-L1327] (MED/incomplete-rate-accounting) dzbdt is updated only for single-fraction transport before avalanching; multi-fraction changes and all later avalanche changes update zb/dzbnow but are omitted from dzbdt.

[L223-L224, L286-L287] (MED/vector-interpolation) Wave-asymmetry velocity components average adjacent ua values but use the first cell's sine/cosine for both terms, rather than rotating each adjacent vector with its own angle.
[L1023-L1033] (MED/directional-inconsistency) Alongshore avalanche scaling omits the max((Sig/grid)^2,1) lower bound used by the cross-shore branch, producing unexplained direction-dependent rates.

[L1144-L1167] (MED/known-mass-error) The code explicitly notes that copying interior bed state into Neumann boundary cells introduces a bed-volume mass error, and no compensating flux or accounting is present.
[L1438-L1443] (MED/invalid-power-domain) Fall-velocity reduction raises 1-ccg to a noninteger power without bounding concentration below one, so out-of-range concentration creates NaNs.
[L1496-L1502] (MED/unstable-filter-weight) The lagged velocity filter uses dt/(cats*Trep) without clamping it to [0,1], so large timesteps produce negative old-state weights and overshoot.

[L1580-L1598] (MED/negative-radicand) Slope/dilatancy factors take square roots of algebraic radicands and later sqrt(srfTotal) without enforcing nonnegativity, so steep or roundoff-affected states can become NaN.
[L1602-L1621] (MED/division-precondition) The Soulsby-Van Rijn velocity cap divides by s%cf without the positive lower bound used by the neighboring Van Thiel branch.

[L1972-L1985, L2055-L2073] (MED/zero-amplitude-singularity) Nielsen friction and streaming divide by Arms while its initial or still-water value can be zero; the streaming transition can also divide by abs(umeanupd)=0.

[L2042-L2050, L2267-L2275, L2663-L2671] (MED/slope-angle-mixup) Fredsoe-Deigaard branches clamp dimensionless bed slope with reposerad (an angle) rather than reposedzdx (its tangent), unlike the corresponding Nielsen implementation.
[L2060-L2066] (LOW/dimensional-consistency) Streaming regime tests compare uvarupd, a squared-velocity statistic, directly with abs(umeanupd), a velocity.
[L2233-L2240] (LOW/zero-flow-direction-bias) Turbulent bed stress uses sign(1,taubxsed), which is positive at exactly zero base stress and therefore imposes a positive x direction in still water.
[L2381-L2418] (MED/stale-optional-state) Suspended-load calculations use taubx_turb even when lwt is disabled, while this routine assigns that array only inside the lwt branch.
[L2638-L2642] (MED/conductivity-singularity) Relative-weight correction divides infiltration by Kzinf with no lower bound, so impermeable cells make facrw invalid.
[L3140-L3152] (MED/wave-parameter-singularity) Bore-slope calculations divide by sigm and, in the mean branch, by an unbounded max(c,sqrt(Hg)), allowing zero-wave states to create invalid values.
[L587] (LOW/dimensional-consistency) vmag takes sqrt(max(vmag2,umin)), comparing squared velocity with a velocity-valued threshold.

audit_member_text: [L464-L490] (HIGH/uninitialized boundary multiplier) pbbedu(nx+1,:) and pbbedv(:,ny+1) are never assigned before whole-array multiplication into Sub/Svb, so boundary transports can consume undefined values even when a zero transport is expected.
[L494-L531] (MED/unchecked relaxation/depth denominator) Concentration updates divide by Tsg, dt, and hh without explicit positivity checks at the addressed cells.
[L1416-L1424,L1508-L1513] (MED/singular grain/fall-velocity input) Zero or invalid grain size/fall velocity can enter negative powers and divisions when computing Sster, ws, and adaptation time.

[L1593-L1599] (MED/inconsistent dilatancy scaling) Suspended-load critical velocity uses Ucr*(1+sqrt(srfRhee)) while bed load uses Ucr*sqrt(1+srfRhee), an unexplained nonlinear inconsistency for the same Shields correction.
[L3099-L3151] (HIGH/dry-cell invalid arithmetic) vT computes H/hh, sqrt(g/hh), and related bore terms for every grid point without a wet mask, so dry cells can contaminate table indices and outputs.
